tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2601W Wi-Fi Essential HD IP Phone is a reliable and cost-effective VoIP desk phone designed for small businesses, offices, call centers, and remote workers. With built-in Wi-Fi connectivity, HD voice quality, and enterprise-grade security, it delivers flexible deployment without requiring network cabling. The GRP2601W is part of Grandstream's carrier-grade GRP series and supports centralized management through GDMS for easy provisioning and maintenance.


Key Features

  • Supports 2 SIP accounts and 2 lines
  • Built-in Wi-Fi connectivity for cable-free deployment
  • HD audio handset and speakerphone
  • 5-way audio conferencing
  • 2.21-inch (132 × 48) LCD display
  • Noise Shield technology with AI noise reduction
  • Electronic Hook Switch (EHS) support for compatible headsets
  • Dual 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports
  • Secure boot, dual firmware images, and encrypted data storage
  • Centralized provisioning and management via GDMS
  • Wall-mountable design
  • Multi-language support
